{{Top|leg}}
'''Kellimin''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. After having an encounter with an [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]], Kellimin described them as "impersonally evil things." Commenting on the entry for the droid in the Datalog in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Kellimin noted that their existence was reason enough to oppose the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] since he allowed them to be used.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
